name: Whispering Gallery
desc: A wave caught circling the inside of a resonator, grazing the rim at every bounce and never quite escaping — the field piles into a necklace of azimuthal lobes hugging the wall, ripples inward through its radial orders and leaks a faint evanescent breath out beyond the edge; the mode beats slowly around as its counter-propagating twin interferes, the rim breathes with thermal expansion, and deforming the cavity into a quadrupole or limacon sends the whole ray dynamics chaotic.

energy.doc: pump power — how hard the mode is driven and how far the faint orders print (master knob)

speed.doc: mode beat rate, rim breathing and cavity precession

density.doc: radial order richness — how many radial fringes ripple inward from the rim — and their confinement depth

order.doc: azimuthal mode number m: the rim carries 2m lobes (auto-capped to what the rim can resolve)

deform.doc: cavity deformation — past a circle the ray dynamics go chaotic and the modes scar

hue.doc: mode colour (190 = cold photonic; try 40 for a warm stone dome)

seed.doc: seed — mount angle, beat phase, substrate grain
